title: Lunchline scribble link
description: A bold, uppercase, tracked link or submit button underlined with a loose hand-drawn marker stroke (two strokes, the second fainter). Fades slightly on hover. Also exports the bare scribble for underlining headings.
notes: the scribble takes currentColor; LunchlineScribble can underline anything (give it a width)
name: lunchline-scribble-link

props.name: children
props.description: the label, set bold, uppercase and tracked

props.name: href
props.description: a link target; without it the component renders a button

props.name: external
props.description: opens the link in a new tab
